name: Cloudlings
description:
About This Game

Steer your very own floating island through the clouds, carefully shaping your land by merging drifting islands into your own. Grow crops, construct buildings, and keep your Cloudlings fed and happy, as your cute little village comes to life.

A Living, Breathing Colony

Your Cloudlings have needs, moods, and little lives of their own. They work, rest, wander, panic, and occasionally get distracted by whatever strange thing catches their attention. You guide the colony by shaping the island, placing buildings, and setting priorities, but the Cloudlings bring the world to life.

Build, Expand, and Thrive

Grow from a small island into a sprawling settlement in the sky. Each island you add brings new space, resources, and terrain, opening up fresh choices for how your colony develops. Unlock new buildings, upgrade your tools, and manage your growing Cloudling population.

Explore a Mysterious Sky

The world beyond your island is filled with crumbling ruins, sky-high mountains, and strange places. Send your Cloudlings out to discover new resources, recover relics, and uncover the story behind the floating islands. Every journey into the clouds can reveal something useful, something strange, or something best left undisturbed.

Weather the Unknown

Beyond the calm, the clouds grow restless. Storms sweep across distant skies, the cold creeps in across frozen regions, and hidden dangers wait in strange corners. Sometimes a Cloudling floats too far and needs bringing home.

The sky is vast, and it's yours to wander.

Features

  • Guide a cute colony of curious, autonomous Cloudlings

  • Build and expand a floating village in the sky

  • Discover drifting islands and merge them into your world

  • Gather resources and manage production chains

  • Unlock new buildings, upgrades, and technology

  • Explore ruins, storms, mountains, and mysterious locations

  • Defend your village from raids, hostile islands, and skyborne threats

  • Watch your settlement grow through warm, cozy, handcrafted pixel art
short_desc: Cloudlings is a cute colony sim set amongst the clouds. Guide a small tribe of curious creatures as they build a floating village, merge drifting islands, manage resources, unlock upgrades, and uncover the mysteries hiding beyond the clouds.
